title: Maler- og beleggstjenester i Troms fylkeskommune
description: Bakgrunn Troms fylkeskommune har ansvar for forvaltning, drift og vedlikehold av en bygningsmasse som blant annet omfatter videregående skoler, tannklinikker og tjenesteboliger i hele Troms. For å ivareta løpende vedlikeholdsbehov og mindre rehabiliterings- og ombyggingsoppdrag er det behov for forutsigbar tilgang til maler- og beleggstjenester. Oppdragsgiver har per i dag ingen avtale på området. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres derfor for å etablere en rammeavtale og sikre kostnadseffektive og rasjonelle innkjøp i tråd med gjeldende regelverk. Et sentralt formål er å forenkle og standardisere bestillingsprosessen på tvers av lokasjoner og bestillere, samt bidra til mer forutsigbar leveranse og kvalitet. Behovet varierer geografisk og mellom lokasjoner. Oppdragene vil i hovedsak omfatte arbeid i eksisterende bygg, ofte mens ordinær drift pågår. Leverandører må derfor kunne planlegge og gjennomføre arbeidene på en måte som tar hensyn til brukere og virksomhet, herunder tilpasse utførelsen til perioder hvor vedlikeholdsarbeidet med fordel kan gjennomføres i skolens ferie- og friperioder. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder etablering av en rammeavtale for maler- og beleggstjenester til Troms fylkeskommunes bygg og eiendommer i Troms. Rammeavtalen skal dekke løpende behov for vedlikehold, utbedringer og mindre ombyggings-/rehabiliteringsoppdrag, samt håndtering av skader ved behov. Leveransen vil omfatte innvendig og utvendig malerarbeid, overflatebehandling samt legging, utskifting og reparasjon av gulvbelegg. Arbeid knyttet til våtrom kan inngå der dette er relevant for oppdragsgivers bygningsmasse. Tjenestene vil primært omfatte eksisterende bygg; ved nybygg kan arbeidene inngå i separate entrepriseformer og dermed falle utenfor rammeavtalen. Oppdragsgiver har delt rammeavtalen inn i fire delkontrakter basert på geografiske avstand (Tromsø, Nord-Troms, Midt-Troms og Sør-Troms), med inntil 1–2 leverandører per delkontrakt. Avrop under rammeavtalen er planlagt gjennomført som direkte bestilling fra oppdragsgiver.

title: Statlig fellesavtale for kjøp av PC-utstyr
description: Anskaffelsens formål er å etablere en fellesavtale som sikrer statlige virksomheter enkel og effektiv tilgang til klientutstyr, herunder PC-klienter, PC-skjermer og Mac med tilhørende tilleggsutstyr og tilleggstjenester, som understøtter en sikker og produktiv arbeidsflate for statlig ansatte. Basert på forbruksdata fra eksisterende avtaler og antall ansatte i deltakende virksomheter, estimerer avtaleeier at det årlig vil bli kjøpt om lag 28 000 PC-klienter, 19 000 PC-skjermer og 1 900 Mac på avtalen. Medregnet forventet kjøp av tilleggsutstyr og tilleggstjenester anslås avtalens årlige omsetning til om lag 600 MNOK. Avtaleeier gjør oppmerksom på at dette er et estimat som ikke er forpliktende for avtaleeier eller de deltakende oppdragsgiverne mht. kjøpsforpliktelser. Maksimal kontraktsverdi for hele avtaleperioden, inklusive eventuelle opsjonsperioder, er satt til 4 000 MNOK. Deltakende virksomheter/oppdragsgivere som deltar på denne fellesavtalen fremgår av bilag 11: Oppdragsgivere omfattet av avtalen.

Deler av leveransene er skilt ut som opsjoner, av blant annet av budsjettmessige hensyn. Hvilke opsjoner som blir løst ut avklares primært i løpet av detaljprosjekteringsfasen. title: Totalentreprise for pumptrack-anlegg på Lærdalsøyri - Lærdal sykkelpark
description: Bakgrunn Lærdal ungdomsråd har sidan 2024 arbeidd for å få etablert eit pumptrack-anlegg på Lærdalsøyri. Saka vart handsama politisk hausten 2025, då formannskapet vedtok at kommunalt areal kan nyttast til tiltaket. Det er løyvd midlar til prosjektet i 2026, og kommunen ønskjer å kontrahera totalentreprenør til prosjektet i 2026 med ferdigstilling innan juni 2027. Formålet med anskaffinga er å etablera eit attraktivt og funksjonelt aktivitetsanlegg for ungdom, med tilbod som fremjar fysisk aktivitet, sosialt samvær og gode møteplassar. Anlegget skal vera ein naturleg samlingsstad for ungdom i sentrumsnære omgjevnader mellom sentrum og fjorden. Sykkelparken skal samstundes i størst mogleg grad kunne nyttast av barn og andre brukargrupper. Plasseringa stiller særlege krav til utforming og gjennomføring. Området ligg sentralt ved innfallsporten til Lærdal og i nærleik til Gamle Lærdalsøyri. Det er difor viktig at anlegget vert godt tilpassa landskap, omgjevnader og verneverdig miljø, og at det held høg estetisk kvalitet. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Lærdal kommune ønskjer å inngå kontrakt om totalentreprise for prosjektering og bygging av eit pumptrack-anlegg på Lærdalsøyri. Oppdraget omfattar ei samla leveranse frå prosjektering til ferdig opparbeidd anlegg. Leverandøren skal også gjennomføra prosess med byggjesøknad. Leveransen skal omfatta eit pumptrack-anlegg med god flyt og ei utforming som er tilpassa ulike aldersgrupper og ferdigheitsnivå. Anlegget skal i tillegg vera ein møteplass med opphaldssone og møblering. Det skal leggjast til rette for trygg ferdsel i og rundt området. Leveransen skal inkludera belysning i samsvar med NS-EN 12193 Idrettsbelysning og krav til denne type anlegg. Universell tilkomst skal inngå som ein del av den samla løysinga. Løysingsforslaget skal ta omsyn til nærleik til veg, ferdsel og verneverdig miljø, og skal utformast med vekt på landskapstilpassing, tryggleik og estetikk. Oppdragsgivar har tilgang på knuste tunnelmassar som skal nyttast i oppbygginga av anlegget der massane er eigna til føremålet, og leverandøren skal leggja dette til grunn i prosjekteringa og utføringa. Lærdal kommune er i ferd med å etablera ein gangveg mellom sentrum og fjorden. Pumptrack-anlegget er planlagt i tilknyting til denne, og tilkomstveg mellom pumptracken og gangvegen skal inngå i totalleveransen. Me viser elles til vedlagde dokument. Anskaffinga gjeld eit prosjekt med planlagd kontrahering ved årsskiftet 2026/2027 og ferdigstilling innan 1.juni 2027.

title: 26261 Moglegheitsstudie Bjørkemoen
description: Konkurransen gjelder levering av moglegheitsstudie for Bjørkemoen. Anskaffelsens verdi anslås til: under nasjonal terskelverdi. Volumet er et estimat og er ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. Oppdragsgiver tar forbehold om avlysning av konkurransen, blant annet i forbindelse med budsjettmessig dekning og politisk godkjenning. Denne anskaffelsen er etter sin art vurdert til å ha en uvesentlig innvirkning på klima og miljø, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5b tredje ledd. Begrunnelsen for dette er at anskaffelsen gjelder kjøp av konsulentbistand/rådgivningstjenester der oppdragsgiver er avskåret fra å påvirke klima og miljøpåvirkningen, siden krav og kriterier som retter seg mot disse elementene ikke vil ha tilstrekkelig tilknytning til leveransen, jf. DFØs miljøveileder. Oppdragsgiver har vurdert anskaffelsen opp mot anskaffelsesloven § 5h, og konkludert med at det ikke stilles krav til lærlinger i denne anskaffelsen da kontraktens hovedelement ikke omfatter arbeider der det er relevant å benytte arbeidskraft med fag- eller svennebrev, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5h 2. ledd bokstav c.

title: Bredbåndsutbygging i Vestfold – tilskuddsordning 2026
description: Bredbåndsprosjektene i regi av Oppdragsgiver er et ledd i arbeidet med å oppnå full bredbåndsdekning i hele Vestfold fylke. Prosjektene skal bidra til utbygging av infrastruktur slik at det blir tilbud om tilgang til internett (bredbånd) for flest mulig husstander/ offentlig virksomheter og næringsvirksomheter i de omtalte områdene. For å kunne handle framtidsrettet tar prosjektene også for seg oppgradering av eksisterende infrastruktur som del av helheten med bredbåndsdekning. Oppdragsgiver har fått statlig støtte til å fortsette støtte til utbygging. Fremtiden krever høyere kapasiteter og de tjenester som leveres via nettet krever stadig høyere kapasitet. Med bakgrunn i dette vil også Oppdragsgiver bidra til at det bygges ut framtidsrettede nett med høy kapasitet der det ellers ikke er kommersielt lønnsomt for en utbygger eller leverandør. Konkurransen gjelder avtale om levering av bredbåndstjenester til totalt 13 ulike områder fordelt på følgende kommuner i Vestfold fylke: · Holmestrand · Horten · Tønsberg · Sandefjord Hvert område utgjør én delkontrakt i denne konkurransen, og hvert område vil evalueres og tildeles separat. For fullstendig oversikt over områdene i den enkelte kommune, se Vedlegg 5 – Adresselister.

title: Konkurranse om - Kartlegging, merking og kontroll av elektriske fordelinger i Stavanger kommunes formålsbygg
description: Stavanger kommune ønsker gjennom dette prosjektet å foreta en systematisk kartlegging av sikringsskap og fordelingstavler i kommunens formålsbygg. Kartleggingen skal gi et oppdatert grunnlag for riktig merking, adgangsbegrensning, risikovurdering, dokumentasjon og videre oppfølging av elektriske anlegg. Arbeidet skal gjennomføres med utgangspunkt i gjeldende regelverk og relevante normer, herunder internkontrollforskriften, FSE, FEL og NEK 400. Formålet er å etablere en samlet og oppdatert oversikt over elektriske fordelinger, registrere relevante tekniske opplysninger, merke adgangsforhold, avdekke mangler og avvik og identifisere anlegg som kan ha behov for nærmere vurdering eller tiltak. Alle sikringsskap, fordelingstavler og andre relevante elektriske fordelinger som omfattes av prosjektet, skal merkes i samsvar med prosjektets krav og gjeldende TFM-merking.Oppdraget gjelder kun Stavanger kommunes formålsbygg. Andre kommunale bygg og installasjoner omfattes ikke av leveransen med mindre dette avtales særskilt.Ordinær utbedring av feil og mangler, beregning av kortslutningsstrømmer og hendelsesenergi, samt merking basert på disse beregningene inngår ikke i den obligatoriske leveransen. Slike arbeider håndteres gjennom avviksregistrering og kan bestilles etter medgått tid som regningsarbeid.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Hafen Trier: Planungs- und Ingenieurleistungen zur Errichtung einer Multi-Purpose-Halle in Anlehnung an die Leistungsphasen 1-9 der HOAI
description: Die Bauherrin beabsichtigt, auf ihrem Grundstück an der Montanstraße in Trier den Bau einer Multi - Purpose-Halle für logistische Nutzungen zu errichten. Dazu ist entsprechend dieser Bekanntmachung ein Verhandlungsverfahren mit einem vorgeschalteten öffentlichen Teilnahmewettbewerb vorgesehen. In der Phase 1 werden Teilnahmeanträge ausgereicht, über deren Auswertung die Teilnehmer an der Angebotsphase ermittelt werden. Dem folgend werden die Verdingungsunterlagen an einen reduzierten Kreis von Bietern versandt. Vorgesehen ist, im Zusammenwirken mit dem zukünftigen Nutzer, im Planungsobjekt ein betriebliches Konzept für Papierlogistik mit Erweiterungsmöglichkeiten auf andere Sorten und Materialien zu realisieren. Die Realisierung dieses Vorhabens erfordert nicht zuletzt aufgrund der engen Budget- und Terminvorgaben eine intensive Kommunikation, Koordination und Zusammenarbeit zwischen und unter allen Projektbeteiligten. Die zum Projekterfolg notwenigen inhaltlichen Anforderungen an andere Mitwirkende sind rechtzeitig zu entwickeln und mit dem Auftraggeber umzusetzen. Die Teilnahmeanträge können auf der Veröffentlichungsplattform abgerufen werden. Eine Kommunikation mit der Auftraggeberin findet ebenfalls dokumentiert über die Plattform statt. Teilnahmeanträge sind zum bekanntgemachten Termin über die Plattform einzureichen. Erforderliche Unterschriften im Teilnahmeantrag sind in diesem gekennzeichnet und durch den Bewerber digital zu unterschreiben. Nicht getätigte Unterschriften führen zum Ausschluss vom Wettbewerb.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Sanierung der zentralen Bettenaufbereitung im Westpfalz-Klinikum Kaiserslautern
description: Die seit 1959 in Haus 7 betriebene Bettenzentrale wurde fortlaufend aus Eigenmitteln instand gehalten. Partielle regelmäßig auftretende Wasserschäden durch das befahrbare Flachdach haben den Gebäudebetrieb beeinträchtigt und mussten temporär behoben werden. Mit der Kernsanierung des Bettenhauses 8 und der damit verbundenen Errichtung einer überdachten Liegendkrankenzufahrt wurde die befahrbare STB-Decke der Bettenzentrale abgeschält und in der gesamten Fläche nun grundlegend saniert. Da die Bettenaufbereitung weiterhin zentral im Haupthaus erfolgt, besteht nun die Möglichkeit, die dort richtig positionierte Bettenzentrale nachhaltig zu sanieren. Neben der bautechnischen Mängelbeseitigung steht die Optimierung der internen Betriebsabläufe im Fokus. Durch die Neugestaltung des Grundrisses sollen logistische Prozesse effizienter gestaltet werden. Insbesondere kreuzungsfreie Wege, speziell die strikte Trennung von reinen und unreinen Arbeitsbereichen, sollen konsequent umgesetzt werden, um die höchsten Hygienestandards dauerhaft zu garantieren. Die Terminplanung des Projektes ist zwingend so auszurichten, dass eine vollständige und prüffähige Aufstellung der HU-Bau im zweiten Quartal 2027 gewährleistet ist.

title: Sanierung Mehrfamilienhaus - Kopernikusring 1-9, 36-44 16227 Eberswalde, Deutschland, Heizung Lüftung Sanitär
description: Die zu vergebenden Leistungen betreffen die Sanierung und Modernisierung der haustechnischen Anlagen für Heizung, Lüftung und Sanitär einschließlich der zugehörigen Demontage-, Bau-, Neben-, Prüf-, Inbetriebnahme- und Dokumentationsleistungen. Die Arbeiten erfolgen überwiegend im bewohnten Bestand. Die beiden Wohngebäude verfügen über jeweils 9 Aufgänge mit 5 Wohnetagen und umfassen insgesamt 180 Wohnungen. Die Gebäude sind voll unterkellert; zwischen oberster Wohnetage und Dach befindet sich ein Drempelgeschoss. Aufzüge sind nicht vorhanden. Sie werden erst und nur insoweit wirksam, wie die beantragte Förderung durch die zuständige Förderstelle bewilligt wird. Der Auftraggeber informiert den Auftragnehmer über den Eintritt der Bedingung unverzüglich in Textform. Bis dahin bestehen keine Ausführungs-, Beschaffungs-, Vorhalte- oder sonstigen kostenverursachenden Leistungspflichten des Auftragnehmers. Wird die Förderung abgelehnt oder tritt die Bedingung nicht bis zum 01.03.2027 ein, entfällt die Verpflichtung zur Ausführung der betroffenen Leistungen. Ausführungsfristen beginnen erst mit Eintritt der Bedingung; weitergehende Ansprüche wegen des Nichteintritts sind ausgeschlossen.

title: Midlertidige pavilloner anvendt til udslusningspladser
description: Udbuddet omfatter etablering af pavillonbyggeri til brug for udslusningspladser for Danmarks Fængsler samt efterfølgende leje af pavillonerne i en periode på 5 år, samt optioner på forlængelse af lejeperiode på i alt 2 år. Efter lejeperiodens udløb skal pavillonerne nedtages og fjernes, herunder skal de berørte arealer retableres i det omfang, det fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Kontraktforholdet består af dels en entrepriseaftale vedrørende projektering, levering, opførelse og færdiggørelse af pavillonbyggeriet, dels en lejeaftale vedrørende den efterfølgende 5-årige lejeperiode. For entrepriseaftalen gælder ABT 18 med Danmarks Fængslers fravigelser og tilføjelser. Pavillonbyggeriet skal danne ramme om udslusningspladser, der skal understøtte en gradvis overgang fra fængsel til et liv uden kriminalitet og bidrage til en sikker og hensigtsmæssig tilbagevenden til samfundet. De nærmere krav til pavillonernes indretning, funktion, tekniske forhold, etablering, lejeperiode, vedligeholdelse samt nedtagning fremgår af udbudsmaterialet.

title: Nestekaasun säiliötoimitukset
description: Nestekaasun säiliötoimitukset Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (jäljempänä Hankintayksikkö) pyytää tarjoustanne nestekaasun (propaani) säiliötoimituksesta Puolustusvoimille tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohde on nestekaasu (propaani) säiliötoimituksena. Vuosikulutusarvio on noin 100 000 kg. Arvio ei sido hankintayksikköä hankkimaan arvioitua määrää nestekaasua vuositasolla, vaan todellisen kulutuksen mukaan. Hankinnan kokonaiskulutusarvio on koko sopimuskaudella, optiokaudet mukaan luettuna, 600 000 kg. Kulutus ei jakaudu tasaisesti vaan voi vaihdella kuukausittain +/- 20%. Ostotilaus tehdään kalenterivuosittain. Hankinta on ehdollinen, sillä edellytyksellä, että hankinnalle myönnetään vuosittainen määräraha.,

title: Sanierung Mehrfamilienhaus - Kopernikusring 1-9, 36-44 16227 Eberswalde, Deutschland, Fassadenarbeiten
description: Das Bauvorhaben umfasst die Sanierung und Modernisierung der bestehenden Mehrfamilienhäuser. Die Gebäude stammen aus dem Jahr 1973 und umfassen insgesamt ca. 180 Wohneinheiten mit einer Gesamtwohnfläche von ca. 10.967 m². Der Wohnungsbestand ist überwiegend vermietet; eine Teilsanierung erfolgte im Jahr 1994. Weitere Leerwohnungsinstandsetzungen finden seit dem Jahr 2025 statt und sind bei der Abstimmung der Schnittstellen zu berücksichtigen. Die zu vergebenden Leistungen betreffen die Instandsetzung und malermäßige Überarbeitung der bestehenden Fassaden einschließlich der zugehörigen Untergrundvorbereitungs-, Schutz-, Anschluss- und Nebenarbeiten. Die vorhandenen Außenwände bestehen gemäß Modernisierungskonzept aus ca. 29 cm Leichtbeton und einem bestehenden Wärmedämmverbundsystem mit ca. 8 cm EPS-Dämmung einschließlich Armierungsschicht und Oberputz. Das vorhandene Wärmedämmverbundsystem soll grundsätzlich erhalten und in schadhaften Bereichen örtlich instand gesetzt bzw. teilweise erneuert werden. Eine vollflächige Erneuerung oder Aufdopplung der Fassadendämmung ist im Modernisierungskonzept nicht vorgesehen. Die Arbeiten erfolgen überwiegend im bewohnten Bestand. Der Schutz der Bewohner, die Nutzbarkeit der erforderlichen Gebäudezugänge sowie der Schutz vorhandener und bereits erneuerter Bauteile sind zu berücksichtigen. Fördervorbehalt BEG EM, aufschiebende Bedingung Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen sind Gegenstand einer beantragten Förderung nach BEG EM. Der Vertrag wird mit Zuschlag geschlossen; die Lieferungs- und Leistungspflichten stehen unter der aufschiebenden Bedingung der Förderzusage. Sie werden erst und nur insoweit wirksam, wie die beantragte Förderung durch die zuständige Förderstelle bewilligt wird. Der Auftraggeber informiert den Auftragnehmer über den Eintritt der Bedingung unverzüglich in Textform. Bis dahin bestehen keine Ausführungs-, Beschaffungs-, Vorhalte- oder sonstigen kostenverursachenden Leistungspflichten des Auftragnehmers. Wird die Förderung abgelehnt oder tritt die Bedingung nicht bis zum 01.03.2027 ein, entfällt die Verpflichtung zur Ausführung der betroffenen Leistungen. Ausführungsfristen beginnen erst mit Eintritt der Bedingung; weitergehende Ansprüche wegen des Nichteintritts sind ausgeschlossen.

title: Integrated Correctional program Model (ICPM) Program
description: An advanced contract award notice (ACAN) is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that a department or agency intends to award a contract for goods, services or construction to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date and time stated in the ACAN, the contracting officer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 1. Definition of the requirement: Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement does not apply to this procurement. The Correctional Service of Canada has a requirement for the delivery of programs to offenders. The main goal of maintenance is to review and refine core self management skills and apply them to real-life situations, obstacles, and high-risk situations to reduce risk to re-offend. One Integrated Correctional program Model (ICPM) program cycle is delivered at a rate of one session per week for 12 weeks on a continuous intake basis. The work will involve the following: 1.1 Objectives: To deliver ICPM to offenders. 1.2 Tasks: The Contractor’s facilitator must: a) Obtains CSC’s Certification through the Quality Review process. b) Provide delivery of the requested number of ICPM sessions to offenders referred by CSC, depending upon the need and according to national directives, policy and guidelines to a maximum of 10 offenders; c) Adhere to the course content by delivering program sessions for the ICPM Community Maintenance Programs in accordance with the program manual. d) Provide classroom space, program equipment and supplies, and all administrative services associated with the project; e) For all offenders who meet the criteria for enrollment to the ICPM Maintenance (MT) - the facilitator(s) must: • conduct file review; • complete pre-program semi-structured interview and interview booklet, return interview booklet to CSC; • complete Pre and Post program testing and assessment interviews and enter the information into Offender Management System (OMS) under Generic Program Performance Measure (GPPM) Screen within the first two sessions; • ensure offenders understanding and signing (or refusal to sign) of program consent form prior to program commencement while documenting such in a casework record in OMS. The consent to participate form must be placed on the Education and Training File; • prepare offender progress reports following the ICPM report template and enter the report into OMS at the completion of the required number of sessions; • forward all reports for review and approval by the Departmental Representative; • review the report with the participant and document same in casework record; • return interview booklets to CSC f) As per most recent Commissioner's Directive 726 - Correctional Programs, the facilitator must complete a casework record in OMS (unless at a site where there is no connectivity) within 1 working day: • when there is an offender contact which is not a requirement of the program, • an individual interview is completed with the offender, • a make-up session has been completed, • there is sharing of information regarding offender participation in the program, • after every session during the offenders’ cycle, • if there is significant information for the Case Management Team. Significant information would include but is not limited to the following: Breach of a condition, new offence, harm to self, harm to others, personal problems that impact risk. g) Each session must follow the same process (see below), be 2 hours in duration and includes a break of up to 15 minutes: • Roundtable and introductions (30 minutes) • Structured segment, each focusing on a specific theme and skills set (50 - 60 minutes) • Alternate Session – An alternate session may be offered in place of a structured segment session based on the identified needs of the participants present for that session, provided that the session is selected from pre-established topics within the program manual (PG 60 in ICPM Manual). • Update Self-Management Plan (10 minutes) • Wrap-up (5 - 10 minutes) h) Programs are to be delivered Monday to Friday in the evenings between 6pm-8pm. 1.3 Training Requirements The Contractor must participate in CSC-funded ICPM program delivery training when required and made available by CSC. • Training is delivered in person by CSC at the Correctional Learning and Development Centre in Moncton, New Brunswick. • Training dates are established by CSC based on operational requirements and the number of referrals identified by the Project Authority. • Initial training for CMP-MT consists of: o 10 business days of initial program delivery training; o 2 days of Indigenous Social History training; and o 7.5 hours of Generic Program Performance Measure (GPPM) training delivered over 2 days. • The Contractor must also attend refresher training when significant changes are made to the program model or when requested by the Project Authority. • The Contractor will be reimbursed for authorized travel costs associated with training. • The Contractor will not be compensated for time spent attending training. 1.4 Performance standards: Delivery of the ICPM: Community Maintenance Programs must be provided in accordance with the following documents: • Correctional Programs (CD 726); • National Correctional Program Standards (CD 726-1); • ICPM: Program Implementation and Program Management Guidelines • Commissioner’s Directives available at: • English: http://www.csc-s.gc.ca/text/legislat_e.shtml • French: http://www.csc-scc.gc.ca/text/legislat_f.shtml • ICPM Community Maintenance Program (Multi Target) Manuals - when connected to OMS; 1.5 Paper consumption: a. Should printed material be required, double sided printing in black and white format is the default unless otherwise specified by the Project Authority. b. The Contractor must ensure printed material is on paper with a minimum recycled content of 30% and/or certified as originating from a sustainably managed forest. c. The Contractor must recycle unneeded printed documents (in accordance with Security Requirements). 1.6 Constraints: 1.6.1 Location of work: a. The Contractor must perform the work at either the Contractor’s place of business or a location determined by the Contractor. b. Travel i. The Contractor will be required to travel to attend trainings as requested by the Project Authority. 1.6.2 Language of Work: The contractor must perform all work in English. 1.6.3 Security Requirements: This contract includes the following security requirements: IT Security Requirements Technical Document, to be included in the contract; and SECURITY REQUIREMENT FOR CANADIAN SUPPLIER: PWGSC FILE No. 21280-26-5322937 – Revision 1 1. The Contractor must, at all times during the performance of the Contract, hold a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS), and obtain approved Document Safeguarding Capability at the level of PROTECTED B, issued by the Contract Security Program (CSP), Public Works and Government Services Canada (PWGSC). 2. The Contractor personnel requiring access to PROTECTED information, assets, or sensitive site(s) must EACH hold a valid RELIABILITY STATUS, granted or approved by the CSP, PWGSC. 3. The Contractor MUST NOT utilize its facilities to process, produce, or store PROTECTED information or assets until the CSP, PWGSC has issued written approval. 4. The Contractor MUST NOT utilize its Information Technology systems to electronically process, produce, or store PROTECTED information until the CSP, PWGSC has issued written approval. After approval has been granted or approved, these tasks may be performed at the level of PROTECTED B, including an IT Link at the level of PROTECTED B. 5. title: Purchase of two (2) Millimetre-Wave Frequency Extender Modules for a Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs) from 110 GHz to 170 GHz
description: NRC Herzberg Astronomy and Astrophysics (HAA) requires extended measurement capabilities in the millimetre-wave frequency range to support ongoing research in characterizing front-end components for low-noise receivers in radio astronomy. Existing Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs) at NRC HAA are currently limited to a maximum operational frequency of 116 GHz. To increase its measurement capability, NRC HAA intends to acquire frequency extender modules covering the 110–170 GHz band. These extenders must integrate with either of HAA's existing analysers (Keysight PNA N5227B and Rohde & Schwarz ZNA67), providing high dynamic range and stable two-port measurements.

title: Venue and Related Services for an International Conference
description: ADVANCE CONTRACT AWARD NOTICE (ACAN) 1. Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) An Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) is a public notice informing suppliers that Canada intends to award a contract for goods, services or construction to a pre-identified supplier, and invites other suppliers to express their interest by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no other supplier submits a statement of capabilities demonstrating how they meet the set requirements in the ACAN by the closing date stated in the ACAN, the buyer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 2. Purpose of the ACAN Venue and Related Services for an International Conference 3. Requirement description Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) has a requirement for a conference venue and associated venue services to host the 12th Our Ocean Conference (OOC12). The venue must support plenary programming, simultaneous side events, bilateral and VIP meetings, media activities, exhibitions, meals and networking, refreshments during registration and dedicated program breaks (e.g., coffee, small bites), and professional event production in a secure, accessible and operationally coherent setting. The venue must be available from May 9th to 11th, 2027, including activities planned for May 9th (e.g. opening reception, Youth Leadership Summit, possible side events, possible Ministerial or VIP meetings) and main conference programming on May 10th and 11, 2027. The Contractor must provide exclusive or appropriately controlled access to the required venue spaces, furniture, utilities, base building services and venue coordination for the conference period, including agreed setup, testing, event and teardown periods. The Contractor shall act as the prime contractor for all venue-related services, including venue rental, catering, registration and accreditation support, security services, audiovisual services, event production, event planning, staging, show management, exhibition services and associated conference delivery requirements. The Contractor may engage subcontractors; however, the Contractor remains fully responsible for the management, coordination and performance of all subcontracted services. If other potential suppliers submit a statement of capabilities during the 15 calendar days posting period that meet the requirements set out in the ACAN, DFO will proceed to a full-tendering process on whether the government's electronic tendering service or through traditional means, in order to award the Contract. If no other supplier submits on or before the closing date, a statement of capabilities meeting the requirements set out in the ACAN, a Contract will be awarded to the pre-selected supplier. 4. Evaluation criteria for assessment of statement of capabilities (minimum essential requirements) Any interested supplier must demonstrate by way of a statement of capabilities that it meets the following requirements: 4.1 A conference venue within the Halifax Regional Municipality available from May 9th to 11th, 2027, including setup, testing and teardown periods, capable of hosting an international conference of approximately 2,500 participants. 4.2 A plenary facility capable of accommodating at least 2,500 participants simultaneously, together with the infrastructure required to support professional event production, audiovisual services and livestreaming. 4.3 Within the same venue complex, a minimum of: a. a minimum of six (6) concurrent breakout or side-event rooms, each capable of accommodating at least 50 participants; b. a minimum of ten (10) private bilateral meeting rooms, each capable of accommodating at least 10 participants; c. one (1) secure meeting room for approximately 100 participants; and d. dedicated space for registration and accreditation, media operations, VIP functions, conference management, security operations, exhibitions, networking and delegate catering. 4.4 The capacity to provide or coordinate catering and refreshment services for approximately 2,500 attendees throughout a multi-day conference, including receptions, meals and scheduled program breaks. 4.5 The capability to act as the prime contractor responsible for the management and coordination of all venue-related services, including venue operations, catering, audiovisual services, event production, registration support, security services and exhibition services, whether delivered directly or through subcontractors. 4.6 A secure operating environment suitable for ministers, senior government officials, international delegations and VIP participants, with controlled access to conference spaces and the ability to support security operations. 4.7 A venue location within walking distance of sufficient hotel accommodation capacity to support conference delegates, officials and VIP participants. 5. Trade Agreements The requirement is subject to the following Trade Agreements: Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA); Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA); Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement; Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) Canada-Honduras Free Trade Agreement; Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement; Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement; Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement; Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement; Canada-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement; World Trade Organization-Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA) 6. Justification for the pre-identified Supplier The pre-identified supplier is the only supplier that we are aware of who offers a product which meets all the Minimum Essential Requirements listed above. 7. Government Contract Regulations exception(s) The following exception(s) to the Government Contracts Regulations is (are) invoked for this procurement under subsection 6(d) – “only one person is capable of performing the work.” 8. Contract Period The Contract period will be from award to May 11, 2027 inclusive. 9. Estimated Cost The estimated value of the Contract is 3,200,000.00 $ CAD (excluding applicable taxes). 10. Name and Address of the Proposed Contractor Halifax Convention Centre (HCC) 1650 Argyle St. Halifax NS B3J 0E6 11. Suppliers’ right to submit a statement of capabilities Suppliers who consider themselves fully qualified and available to provide the services/goods described herein, may submit a Statement of Capabilities in writing, by e-mail, to the contact person identified in this Notice on or before the closing date and time of this Notice. The Statement of Capabilities must clearly demonstrate how the supplier meets the advertised requirements. 12. Closing Date The closing date for a submission of a Statement of Capabilities is November 25, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. EST. 13. Requests for information and submission of statements of capabilities Request for information and statements of capabilities must be sent before the date and time indicated in Article 13, to: Contract Authority Manon Paulin, Senior Contracting Officer Procurement and Material Management Fisheries and Oceans Canada Telephone : 438-468-3247 Email : DFO.Tenders-Soumissions.MPO@dfo-mpo.gc.ca

description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT (NPP) Reissue of Solicitation of Offers. The Department of National Defence (DND), in support of the Canadian Forces Health Services (CFHS), has a requirement for the supply, delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, documentation, training, and warranty support of Mobile Treatment Centre (MTC) cap-style slide-in modules. title: Calcium Trisodium Pentetate (Ca-DTPA) ampoules
description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT The Department of National Defence (DND), through the Strategic Medical Countermeasures Program (SMCP) on behalf of the Canadian Forces Health Services Group (CF H Svcs Gp), has a requirement for the supply of Calcium Trisodium Pentetate (Ca-DTPA) ampoules for the treatment of Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) personnel who may have been exposed to radioactive contamination involving transuranic elements. The Ca-DTPA product must consist of sterile Calcium Trisodium Pentetate solution for injection, containing approximately 1,000 mg to 1,055 mg of active ingredient in a 5 mL ampoule suitable for intravenous administration. The product is intended for use as a medical countermeasure to enhance the elimination of internally deposited radioactive transuranic elements, including plutonium, americium and curium, following confirmed or suspected radiological exposure. The product must meet all applicable regulatory, quality assurance, packaging, labelling and shelf-life requirements specified in the solicitation documents. The initial requirement consists of the supply of 250 Ca-DTPA ampoules for delivery no later than 1 March 2027. The resulting contract is anticipated to be valid from contract award date to 31 March 2031 and includes additional scheduled deliveries of 250 ampoules in Fiscal Year 2027-2028 and 250 ampoules in Fiscal Year 2028-2029. The contract will also include an option for up to an additional 500 ampoules exercisable during the contract period. This procurement will be conducted through an Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN). The Government of Canada has identified Heyl Chemisch-pharmazeutische Fabrik GmbH & Co. KG as the only supplier currently known to satisfy the operational, clinical and technical requirements associated with this requirement. Suppliers that consider themselves fully qualified and capable of meeting the complete requirement may submit a Statement of Capabilities during the posting period. The Crown retains the rights to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Barring any applicable trade agreement exceptions or other legal restrictions, eligible suppliers may participate in this solicitation process. These seminars are provided free of charge.

description: Perho Liiketalousopisto Oy:n tukkuhankinnat Hankinnan kohteena on elintarvikkeiden, alkoholittomien ja alkoholijuomien ja non-food -tuotteiden hankinta ja niiden toimitukset Perho Liiketalousopisto Oy:n ravintoloihin ja opetuskeittiöihin Helsingissä (Ravintola Perho ja ravintola Herkku Töölössä ja ravintola Perhon Helmi Malmilla). Hankinnan tavoitteena on löytää yksi (1) päätukkutoimittaja, jonka toimitus- ja tilausajat vastaavat Perho Liiketalousopisto Oy:n ravintoloiden tarpeita. Tavaratoimitusten tulee tapahtua vastuullisesti, tehokkaasti, toimitusvarmasti ja edullisesti. Ravintoloissa on pienet varastointimahdollisuudet, joten niistä tehdään tilauksia päivittäin. Vähäisestä varastotilasta johtuen tukusta täytyy pystyä tilaamaan myös purettuja myyntieriä. Tarkemmat kuvaukset hankinnan sisällöstä löytyy tarjouspyynnön kohdasta 'Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit'.,

title: Arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailu: Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulun keskustakampus
description: Arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailu: Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulun keskustakampus Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulu (HAMK) järjestää Hämeenlinnan Hämeensaaren uuden keskustakampuksen suunnittelusta arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailun yhteistyössä Hämeenlinnan kaupungin ja Suomen Arkkitehtiliitto SAFA:n kanssa. Kilpailutehtävänä on suunnitella arkkitehtonisesti korkeatasoinen ja toiminnallinen uusi keskustakampuskokonaisuus, joka palvelee HAMKia, sekä hämeenlinnalaisia. Uudisrakentamisen määrä on hankkeen ensimmäisen vaiheen kokonaan toteuduttua arviolta 12 000 hym². Kilpailussa tutkitaan kampusrakennuksen ja sen piharatkaisun liittymistä kaupunkirakenteeseen, Vanajaveden rantaan, julkisiin ulkotiloihin, liikenneverkkoon ja ympäröivään keskustaan. Hankkeessa haetaan pontta alueen kehittämisen käynnistymiselle huomioiden kytkeytyminen Hämeenlinnan keskustaan. Suunnittelukilpailun voittajan kanssa voidaan tehdä palveluhankintasopimus hankkeen asemakaavan kehittämisestä ja myöhemmästä jatko- ja toteutussuunnittelusta. Hankkeen lopullisen toteutumisen edellytyksenä on lainvoimainen asemakaava ja rahoituksen varmistuminen. Kilpailu on kaksivaiheinen niin, että ensimmäisessä vaiheessa pyydetään kaikilta halukkailta osallistujilta osallistumishakemukset. Osallistumishakemukset arvioidaan osallistumispyynnöllä esitettyjen vertailukriteereiden mukaisesti ja viisi (5) parasta kelpoisuusvaatimukset täyttävää hakijaa valitaan toiseen vaiheeseen varsinaiseen suunnittelukilpailuun. Viidelle valitulle kilpailijalle maksetaan kullekin 15 000 euroa (+alv) kilpailuohjelman mukaisesta määräajassa palautetusta kilpailutyöstä. Palkkiot maksetaan Suomen Arkkitehtiliiton kautta ja SAFA perii 7 % palkinnoista kilpailusääntöjensä mukaisesti. Kilpailun tarkemmat tiedot ja aikataulu on esitetty osallistumispyynnön liitteenä olevassa kilpailuohjelman luonnoksessa.,

title: Alkolukkojen ja niiden asennus-, huolto- ja kalibrointipalvelujen hankinta
description: Alkolukkojen ja niiden asennus-, huolto- ja kalibrointipalvelujen hankinta Hankinnan kohteena on ajoneuvoihin asennettavat alkolukot ja niiden vaihdettavat suukappaleet sekä alkolukkoihin liittyvät palvelut kuten asennus-, kalibrointi- ja huoltopalvelut. title: Finland – Organisation of architectural design contests – Arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailu: Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulun keskustakampus
description: Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulu (HAMK) järjestää Hämeenlinnan Hämeensaaren uuden keskustakampuksen suunnittelusta arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailun yhteistyössä Hämeenlinnan kaupungin ja Suomen Arkkitehtiliitto SAFA:n kanssa. Kilpailutehtävänä on suunnitella arkkitehtonisesti korkeatasoinen ja toiminnallinen uusi keskustakampuskokonaisuus, joka palvelee HAMKia, sekä hämeenlinnalaisia. Uudisrakentamisen määrä on hankkeen ensimmäisen vaiheen kokonaan toteuduttua arviolta 12 000 hym². Kilpailussa tutkitaan kampusrakennuksen ja sen piharatkaisun liittymistä kaupunkirakenteeseen, Vanajaveden rantaan, julkisiin ulkotiloihin, liikenneverkkoon ja ympäröivään keskustaan. Hankkeessa haetaan pontta alueen kehittämisen käynnistymiselle huomioiden kytkeytyminen Hämeenlinnan keskustaan. Suunnittelukilpailun voittajan kanssa voidaan tehdä palveluhankintasopimus hankkeen asemakaavan kehittämisestä ja myöhemmästä jatko- ja toteutussuunnittelusta. Hankkeen lopullisen toteutumisen edellytyksenä on lainvoimainen asemakaava ja rahoituksen varmistuminen. Kilpailu on kaksivaiheinen niin, että ensimmäisessä vaiheessa pyydetään kaikilta halukkailta osallistujilta osallistumishakemukset. Osallistumishakemukset arvioidaan osallistumispyynnöllä esitettyjen vertailukriteereiden mukaisesti ja viisi (5) parasta kelpoisuusvaatimukset täyttävää hakijaa valitaan toiseen vaiheeseen varsinaiseen suunnittelukilpailuun. Viidelle valitulle kilpailijalle maksetaan kullekin 15 000 euroa (+alv) kilpailuohjelman mukaisesta määräajassa palautetusta kilpailutyöstä. Palkkiot maksetaan Suomen Arkkitehtiliiton kautta ja SAFA perii 7 % palkinnoista kilpailusääntöjensä mukaisesti. Kilpailun tarkemmat tiedot ja aikataulu on esitetty osallistumispyynnön liitteenä olevassa kilpailuohjelman luonnoksessa.

The contractor shall provide options for including existing subscriptions from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). Provide an option for DLS to add new titles as the contractor adds to its holdings through acquisition or publication of a new title. description: THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR A COMPETITIVE PROPOSAL OR QUOTATION. The Defense Logistics Agency � Energy (DLA Energy), Direct Delivery Fuels Division, hereby issues this Notice of Intent (NOI) to inform industry and prospective contractors of the Government's intent to solicit, negotiate, and award a sole-source, Firm-Fixed-Price contract with Economic Price Adjustment (FFP w/ EPA) for commercial ground fuels in accordance with the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO), FAR Part 12 (Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services). The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) NAICS code is 324110 � Petroleum Refineries with a size standard of 1500 employees. The Product of Service Code for this requirement is 9140. This will not be a small business set aside under the Small Business Administration (SBA) size standard for this sector. The proposed contract action is being conducted under the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO FAR 6.103-1, "Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements." This is a new requirement for the procurement and direct delivery of bulk of ground fuels for Logistics Support Area (LSA) Jenkins and Prince Sultan Air Base (PSAB) in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia as follows: CLIN Fuel Product NSN Quantity Location 0001 Diesel Fuel #2 (DF2) 9140-00-286-5294 1,440,000 US Gallons LSA Jenkins, SA 0002 Diesel Fuel #2 (DF2) 9140-00-286-5294 3,240,000 US Gallons PSAB, SA 0003 Gasoline, Mid Unl (MUM) 9130-01-272-0983 2,160,000 US Gallons PSAB, SA The anticipated period of performance is from December 1, 2026 through November 30, 2029 with a six (6)-month option. The Government intends to award this requirement to Saudi Naval Support Company. Due to operational imperatives, base defense and physical security mandates, and strict installation access limitations enforced by Host Nation military authorities at LSA Jenkins and PSAB, uninterrupted fuel delivery is vital to continuous operations. Saudi Naval Support Company is currently the only vendor identified with the existing infrastructure, security clearances, vetted transportation fleets, and validated installation access credentials capable of immediate and uncompromised performance without causing unacceptable operational disruptions. This notice is not a formal request for competitive proposals or quotes. No solicitation package will be issued publicly via SAM.gov for competitive submission, and telephone inquiries will not be accepted. Unsolicited proposals or quotes received will not be accepted for award. However, all responsible sources who believe they possess the legitimate capability, infrastructure, supply chain assurance, and verified base access to perform this requirement may submit a formal Capability Statement, only if received by the closing date and time of this notice. Generic capability statements, marketing materials, or brochures will not be considered. A determination not to compete the proposed requirement based upon the responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Any response submitted must demonstrate clear, compelling, and convincing evidence that the respondent can satisfy the requirement without causing mission failure or supply interruption, and that opening competition would be advantageous to the Government. However, any responsible vendor believes they have the necessary access and capability to provide continuous, uninterrupted fuel support may submit a capability statement which shall be considered by the agency, Mandatory Submission Requirements Interested parties submitting capability statements must provide the following: Responses must include: Business name Evidence of System for Award Management (SAM) registration Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) Commercial/North Atlantic Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE/NCAGE) Code Joint Contingency Contracting System (JCCS) � Registered and Approved Demonstrated capability to meet all requirements Evidence of LSA Jenkins and PSAB Base Access approval - Verifiable documentation confirming active base access approvals, driver badging, and host nation entry permits for commercial fuel tanker operations at both LSA Jenkins and PSAB Suppliers and Transportation Letters of Commitment Certificate of Analysis/Certificate of Quality (COA/COQ) for each product � Recent (within 90 days), certified Certificate of Analysis (COA) / Certificate of Quality (COQ) verifying product conformance with applicable commercial for each fuel type. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed procurement based on the responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. All interested parties who are responsible, certified, and capable shall identify their interest. The DEADLINE to submit your capability statement showing your ability to meet the full scope of this requirement are due on or before November 25, 2026 by 9:00 am Eastern Standard Time (EST) by email to Regina Daniels, Contract Specialist, at regina.daniels@dla.mil and Georgia Dotson, Contracting Officer, at Georgia.Dotson@dla.mil. description: Kaavan tuotantojärjestelmän hankinta Kaupunkiympäristön toimiala (KYMP) on toteuttamassa Kaavan tuotantojärjestelmän hankintaa. Helsingin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala hankkii kaavan tuotantojärjestelmän, jolla pystyy tuottamaan kansallisen kaavatietomallin mukaista asema- ja yleiskaavaa ja toimittamaan ne Suomen ympäristökeskuksen ylläpitämään rakennetun ympäristön tietojärjestelmään viimeistään vuoden 2029 alusta alkaen. title: Develop Wayfinding Strategy for Mississippi Lake National Wildlife Area (MLNWA), St Clair National Wildlife Area (SCNWA) and Big Creek National Wildlife Area (BCNWA)
description: Background Canadian Wildlife Service (CWS) Ontario manages 10 National Wildlife Areas in Ontario. Two of these, Prince Edward Point National Wildlife Area (PEPNWA) and Big Creek National Wildlife Area (BCNWA) have also been designated as Connecting Canadians to Nature sites. Out of more than 60 National Wildlife Areas across the country only 10 have been designated as Connecting Canadians to Nature sites. These 10 sites as well as select few of the other NWAs are open to the public and provide opportunities for people to experience and connect with nature. CWS Ontario is working to improve accessibility and enhance visitors’ experiences at publicly accessible NWAs in Ontario. In 2025, a wayfinding strategy and upgrades to signage were completed at PEPNWA to improve accessibility for visitors. CWS Ontario is now looking to implement similar improvements at other publicly accessible NWAs in the province using guidance developed for PEPNWA. Objective Develop Wayfinding Strategy for Mississippi Lake National Wildlife Area (MLNWA), St Clair National Wildlife Area (SCNWA) and Big Creek National Wildlife Area (BCNWA) and complete signage designs as required based on outcomes of individual site visits and using guidance outlined in Design Brief (Appendix B) and Wayfinding Signage Design Intent (Appendix C) previously prepared for PEPNWA.
